svg.title: Kubernetes Observability Stack Architecture
svg.desc: Application pods instrumented with OTel SDK push telemetry to the OpenTelemetry Collector, which fans out to Prometheus for metrics, Loki for logs, and Grafana Tempo for traces — all visualised in a single Grafana dashboard.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do you instrument a Kubernetes pod with the OpenTelemetry SDK?')
sendPrompt('What signals does the OpenTelemetry SDK automatically capture from my application?')
sendPrompt('How does the OTel Collector handle telemetry from multiple services concurrently?')
sendPrompt('How do I configure an OpenTelemetry Collector pipeline with exporters for Prometheus, Loki and Tempo?')
sendPrompt('How does kube-prometheus-stack deploy Prometheus and what does it scrape by default in Kubernetes?')
sendPrompt('How does Grafana Loki store logs and why is it more lightweight than Elasticsearch?')
sendPrompt('Why is Grafana Tempo a better choice than Jaeger for a learning project already using Prometheus and Grafana?')
sendPrompt('How do I add Prometheus, Loki and Tempo as data sources in Grafana and build a unified observability dashboard?')

svg.text: One pane of glass — metrics · logs · traces
